_readme: OPTIONAL headless-browser provider. Copy to data/site-provider.json and set
enabled=true. Only use this against a site you own or whose robots.txt and
terms of service permit automated access — for example your own licensed
Requires: BROWSER_ENABLED=true and `npm i playwright` + `npx playwright install chromium`.
searchUrl may contain {q} for a GET-based search page. If it does not, the
browser fills inputSelector and clicks submitSelector (or presses Enter).
Selectors are plain CSS, relative to the rendered page.
detail.links yields the offers shown in the card. Links ending in .mp4/.mkv/
webm are treated as direct media; everything else is sent as a page link.
